notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric, Rogue and/or Warrior.
description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Ardent Electromancer from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Hoverguard Sweepers from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it and Ardent Electromancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control at least three creatures in your party when Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, this combo nets infinite {R}.
